svg.title: HE-02.2 animated: plant run F-07
svg.desc: Synthetic (DSR-12), no evidence credit. Looping animation of plant run F-07 for HE-02.2: the Corolla's lateral offset on a straightened road from 1 s before the fault to 4.3 s after it, the offset plot with a moving cursor and the 0.5 s FTTI band, and the events: fault: EPS fault: LKA_STATE 9, assist lost at 0.00 s; panda refuses LKA frames at 0.02 s; panda revokes steering authority at 0.07 s; panda siren (the driver's cue) at 0.80 s; body on the 3.7 m lane line at 2.28 s; driver starts to correct at 2.30 s.
svg.text: Plant run F-07: rural right curve (2.0 m/s²) at 80 km/h, outside the ODD, fault at curve entry
road straightened; the car keeps its place, the road moves
body on the 3.7 m lane line (0.86 m)

g.text: fault: EPS fault: LKA_STATE 9, assist lost
